summary_1line: Yajnavalkya explains post‑death soul paths, death omens, meditation on the Supreme, and narrates receiving Vedic knowledge from Surya and teaching Prakriti–Purusha philosophy.
themes: paths of the soul after death

image_candidates.scene_text: The goddess Saraswati enters Yajnavalkya’s open mouth as the radiant Sun‑god Surya stands before him, filling him with blazing knowledge.
Overwhelmed by the burning energy of Saraswati within him, Yajnavalkya plunges into a flowing river while Surya watches from the sky.
A dying man’s soul rises from the crown of his head like a subtle light, ascending toward the luminous realm of Brahman.
